title: Overview layout pass: grouped Needs you, aligned rows, quiet sidebar, richer detail

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
UI review pass on 2026-10-22 (rule u10), from an owner screenshot of the Overview on ork with 15 needs. The owner chose the grouped layout; adj 149 (ui.overview-layout) holds the choices for decision. Layout and wording are *proposed* until 149 is decided.

Found:
- The project column repeats on every row, even when one project is selected. Its width is the longest registered name (internal/tui/overview.go:194-197), so on a 14-project registry the text starts about 16 columns in.
- Decision titles start in different columns because keys differ in length (overview.go:82-83). Every decision row repeats the bold yellow "? decision" label, and every held row ends in "(needs-owner)" (overview.go:87-90), which the kind already says.
- The detail line repeats the selected row word for word (detailLines, overview.go:283-290). It sits right under the rows with no rule, and it adds nothing, although inbox records already carry Options and Recommendation (internal/adjcli/adjcli.go:49-50).
- The sidebar shows "0" on most projects, and "Needs you" has no total (internal/tui/view.go:118-189).
- The status line shows "pending 0" (view.go:236-246).
- The cursor bar stops where the row's text ends (rowLine, overview.go:238-260).
- The chrome is ASCII "|" and "-" (view.go:98, view.go:182).

Not here: engine row labels and stopped age (S33), denial dedupe (S43), the Ready to land list (S09), version and logo (S54), keys (S85).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/overview.go`: rows (:55-149) gain a group for each needs row; overview (:192-235) draws the sub-groups and heading counts; rowLine (:238-260) aligns the columns, drops the project column when one project is selected, and pads the cursor row to the pane width; detailLines (:283-290) builds the richer detail.
- `internal/tui/view.go`: screen (:29-116) adds a rule above the detail lines and uses the theme's rule characters; sidebar (:118-189) hides zero counts, adds the Needs you total and right-aligns the badges; statusLine (:236-246) hides pending at 0.
- `internal/tui/theme.go`: rule characters and a group-heading style for both themes.
- `internal/tui/model.go`: needs (:69) is reused for the Needs you total.
- `internal/tui/tui_test.go`, `internal/tui/sidebar_test.go`, `internal/tui/golden_test.go`: the new tests, and updates to tests that pin the old text.
- `testdata/golden/`: overview-*.txt, engine-*.txt, pane-*.txt and action-*.txt change. Regenerate with go test ./internal/tui -update and review the diff.
- `docs/dashboard.md`: the Layout sketch and the Overview section.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestNeedsYouGroupsByKind: Needs you shows the sub-groups Decisions, Held, Stopped, Paused and Approve in that order, each with its count, and skips an empty group. Each row keeps its symbol (?, #, x and the engine symbols from S33), so the mono theme still says the kind.
- TestSectionHeadingsCarryCounts: "Needs you 15" and "Running 0".
- TestProjectColumnOnlyOnAllProjects: with one project selected, rows have no project column; on Needs you the column is as wide as the longest name among projects that have rows.
- TestDecisionTitlesAlign: the titles of decision rows with keys of different lengths start in one column.
- TestHeldRowHasNoFlagSuffix: a held row does not end in "(needs-owner)".
- TestCursorBarFillsThePane: the selected row's rendered width equals the pane width.
- TestDecisionDetailShowsOptions: the detail line for a decision shows its status, option count and recommended label, not the row text.
- TestSidebarHidesZeroCounts: a project with no needs shows no number; "Needs you" shows the total of all projects' needs.
- TestRulesFallBackToASCII: with a non-UTF-8 locale (LANG=C), the rules are "|" and "-"; with UTF-8 they are box-drawing lines.
- TestStatusLineHidesPendingAtZero: "pending" shows only when the poller has calls pending.
- Goldens: overview at 80x24, 100x30 and 120x40, colour and mono.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
0. Check that adj 149 is decided and follow it. If it is decided another way, stop and re-plan.
1. Write the failing tests first (Failing tests). Run go test ./internal/tui -run 'TestNeedsYouGroups|TestSectionHeadings|TestProjectColumn|TestDecisionTitles|TestHeldRow|TestCursorBar|TestDecisionDetail|TestSidebarHides|TestRulesFallBack|TestStatusLineHides' and watch each fail for its stated reason.
2. overview.go: give ovRow a group (decision, held, stopped, paused, approve, error). rows keeps its order inside a group. overview draws a group heading ("Decisions 8") with th.Heading or a new group style, then the group's rows. The cursor order follows the drawn order.
3. overview.go: the kind column becomes a one-character symbol plus a space. Decision rows split into id, key and title columns. The key column is as wide as the longest key in the group, capped at a third of the pane, and a longer key is cut with "...". Drop the "(needs-owner)" suffix (overview.go:89).
4. overview.go: compute nameW only from projects that have rows, and set it to 0 when m.active >= 0. rowLine pads the selected row to w before rendering it with TabActive.
5. overview.go detailLines: a decision shows "#ID open | N options | recommends LABEL" and then the title wrapped. Other rows keep their full text until S33 and S85 extend them.
6. view.go: draw a rule between the body and the detail lines. Take the rule characters from the theme. Use box-drawing when LANG, LC_ALL or LC_CTYPE names UTF-8, and ASCII otherwise; reuse internal/brand's locale check if S54 has landed.
7. view.go sidebar: no number for zero needs, the Needs you row shows the total, and badges right-align at w-2. statusLine: drop "pending N" at 0.
8. docs/dashboard.md: update the Layout sketch and the Overview text to match.
9. Mutation check: remove the grouping in step 2 and confirm TestNeedsYouGroupsByKind fails; restore it.
10. go test ./internal/tui -update, then review every golden diff by eye at 80x24 (cut rows still fit, ids whole).

Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): adj 149 (ui.overview-layout) is decided grouped by the owner (record to be filed). Follow Implement step 0.

adj 149 is decided (grouped, 2026-10-23), so step 0 is satisfied.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review every changed file in testdata/golden/ by eye.
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .   (expect no output)
- slicer check
- adj lint
- UI pass (rule u10): run the TUI at 80x24 and 120x40, colour and NO_COLOR, and compare with the goldens.
